programs.name: GWI Scholars Program (formerly Summer Intensive Program)

source.note: Re-read 2026-08-07: girlswhoinvest.org/sip now returns 404; the program is restructured as the GWI Scholars Program (unified curriculum, then Online Intensive Program or Summer Intensive Program; only Internship Track Scholars matched with internships reach SIP). Page states the application for the 2027 GWI Scholars Program is now open.

class_year.quote: All applicants must hold first-year or sophomore status, with an expected graduation date between fall 2028 and spring 2030.

sponsorship.quote: If opting into consideration for the Internship Track, please be advised that the majority of internship matches facilitated by GWI require unrestricted authorization to work in the U.S. and will not be filled by students on Curricular Practical Training (CPT), or by those who would otherwise need visa sponsorship in the future (i.e., STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, E-3, etc.).
sponsorship.notes: Same page separately states, of the Scholars Program itself: "GWI does not limit or exclude applications according to citizenship status. The GWI Scholars Program is largely a remote, educational experience, and has no participation restrictions related to work authorization."

process.quote: The priority deadline to apply to the 2027 GWI Scholars program is September 15, 2026. The final deadline to apply is October 15, 2026.

compensation.quote: Sophomore applicants can opt into consideration for our Internship Track to become eligible candidates for paid internships at GWI Partner firms.

cooling_off.quote: Yes. If you're not admitted to the GWI Scholars Program during your first-year, you're welcome and encouraged to reapply as a sophomore. Each application is evaluated on its own merits, so a prior application doesn't affect your eligibility or candidacy in a future cycle.
cooling_off.notes: The quoted sentences answer the FAQ question "If I wasn't admitted as a first-year applicant, can I reapply as a sophomore the following academic year?" The answer is explicitly permissive: no waiting period stated, and the firm states a prior application carries no penalty. Recorded as stated rather than silent for the same reason as Blackstone -- the firm addresses the question in its own words. This row previously read silent, with the note "No sentence addressing reapplication ... was found on either the SIP or apply-FAQ pages during this check." The sentence was on the cited page and was missed. Note the firm frames reapplication as a first-year applicant returning as a sophomore, which is the only repeat its own class-year rule leaves room for.

programs.opens: open as of 2026-08-07 (2027 GWI Scholars Program)
programs.closes: priority deadline September 15, 2026; final deadline October 15, 2026

class_year.summary_note: Open to all genders per FAQ
